source_snapshot.procedure: Reserve SEL, send raw 0x0a/0x47 with CLR and 0xaa, then query erase status with operation byte 0; source also generically clears logs before test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Commands succeed; status 01 complete/00 in progress; status query alone must not clear a nonempty SEL.

original_test_intent: Erase the complete SEL once under explicit authorization, validate in-progress/completed status semantics and prove the final empty state while retaining immutable prior evidence.
original_method: Obtain a same-session reservation, issue exact Storage 0x0a/0x47 clear, poll documented status and verify empty SEL.
manual_activity: Owner confirms exact BMC, full-log irreversible scope, export hash, reason and absence of evidence hold immediately before the one clear.
safety_requirements: Never use as generic pre-test cleanup
engineer_actions: Approve evidence retention and maintenance window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level sel clear may perform the erase but skips the required raw reservation/status checkpoint, uses unsafe SSH and fixed sleep, and lacks evidence preservation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact protected 0x0a/0x42 reservation plus 0x0a/0x47 clear/status package after immutable export and fresh confirmation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw CLR bytes, criteria, scripts and timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Export/hash every required entry, ensure no hold, reserve in-session, confirm full-log erase, send one CLR request, poll status to complete or timeout, then verify count/free-space/entry state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes circular pre-clear and adds irreversible-action evidence, authorization and bounded status handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A high-level success message or empty read alone does not validate raw reservation/status semantics; single-entry delete is separate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: No reliable rollback exists; the export/audit becomes the only retained fault-history record.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API may satisfy project clear functionality if it has equivalent export, authorization, status and final-state evidence; it does not prove raw 0x0a/0x47 coverage if that method is skipped.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source circularly clears logs before testing the clear and criteria do not require preserving evidence. DeepSeek replaces exact raw status semantics with unsafe high-level clear and fixed sleep.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The clear/status protocol and destructive intent are explicit. Missing target values, export and approval are execution readiness inputs, so the case requires packaging/confirmation rather than permanent BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Preserves full erase coverage while preventing automatic evidence destruction and requiring exact status and immutable audit proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Full SEL erase is technically packageable but irreversible and compliance-sensitive. Automation may execute only one prevalidated sequence after fresh human confirmation and complete evidence preservation.
